codes.name: Malformed
codes.summary: The text is not a report.
codes.template: The text is not a valid report: the problem is at line {line}, column {column}.

codes.name: UnsupportedSchema
codes.summary: The report uses a schema version this build cannot read.
codes.template: Schema version {found} is not supported. This build reads version {supported}.

codes.name: NotFinite
codes.summary: A number given as a length or an angle is not finite.
codes.template: The number given is {value}, which is not finite in occam's internal units.

codes.name: ToleranceOutOfRange
codes.summary: A tolerance must be a finite number greater than zero.
codes.template: The tolerance {tolerance} is not a finite number greater than zero.

codes.name: ToleranceBelowModel
codes.summary: An operation cannot work to a finer tolerance than its model is built to.
codes.template: The tolerance asked for, {requested}, is finer than the model's tolerance, {model}.

codes.name: ToleranceUsed
codes.summary: The tolerance an operation worked to.
codes.template: The operation worked to a tolerance of {tolerance}.

codes.name: BadArgument
codes.summary: A command-line argument is missing or is not understood.
codes.template: The command line is wrong at {parameter}. `occam help` lists the commands and what each takes.

codes.name: FileNotRead
codes.summary: A file the command line names could not be read.
codes.template: The file {given}, given as {parameter}, could not be read.

codes.name: FileNotWritten
codes.summary: The model could not be written to the file the command line names, which is left as it was.
codes.template: The model could not be written to {given}, given as {parameter}; the file is as it was.

codes.name: ThreadsUnavailable
codes.summary: The threads asked for could not be started.
codes.template: {threads} threads could not be started on this machine.

codes.name: DegenerateDirection
codes.summary: A vector no longer than the model's tolerance has no direction.
codes.template: The vector is {length} long, no longer than the tolerance of {tolerance}, so it has no direction.

codes.name: UndefinedParameter
codes.summary: A curve or surface is not defined at the parameter asked for.
codes.template: The parameter {parameter} is outside the domain from {low} to {high}.

codes.name: SizeNotPositive
codes.summary: A curve or surface was given a size that is not a finite number greater than zero.
codes.template: The size given, {size}, is not a finite number greater than zero.

codes.name: OutOfRange
codes.summary: A curve or surface was given a size or an angle outside the range its form allows.
codes.template: The value given, {value}, is not strictly between {low} and {high}.

codes.name: WrongCount
codes.summary: A curve or surface was given the wrong number of knots, poles or weights.
codes.template: {found} were given where {needed} are needed.

codes.name: KnotsNotValid
codes.summary: A B-spline's knots must not decrease, and may repeat at most its degree times inside and once more at an end.
codes.template: Knot {index}, {knot}, is out of order or repeated more often than the degree allows.

codes.name: WeightNotPositive
codes.summary: A rational curve or surface was given a weight that is not a finite number greater than zero.
codes.template: Weight {index} is {weight}, which is not a finite number greater than zero.

codes.name: NoDerivative
codes.summary: A surface was asked for a derivative of an order it does not have.
codes.template: A derivative of order {order} was asked for, and this surface has them to order {highest}.

codes.name: TriangleNotValid
codes.summary: A mesh's triangle must name three of its vertices, run anticlockwise with some area in the parameters, and overlap no other there.
codes.template: Triangle {index} names a vertex there is not, does not run anticlockwise with some area in the parameters, or overlaps another there.

codes.name: SweptAlongItself
codes.summary: A curve swept along a direction it runs along makes no surface, or one with an edge at infinity.
codes.template: The curve runs along {direction}, the direction it is swept along: trim it, or sweep it another way.

codes.name: NotSmooth
codes.summary: An offset needs a surface with second derivatives, so that its normal is continuous.
codes.template: The surface has derivatives to order {highest}, and an offset needs them to order {needed}.

codes.name: EdgeOffSurface
codes.summary: A curve in a face's parameters does not lie along its edge's curve within the band.
codes.template: The edge's curve on the face is {gap} from its own at {point}, more than the band of {band}.

codes.name: NotInPlane
codes.summary: A parameter curve must be drawn in the plane z = 0, whose x and y are the face's parameters.
codes.template: The curve reaches {height} from the plane z = 0, in which a parameter curve is drawn.

codes.name: SingularPoint
codes.summary: A curve has no tangent, or a surface no normal, where its derivatives span no direction.
codes.template: The derivatives at the parameter asked span {span}, too little to give a direction there.

codes.name: JoinBelowContinuity
codes.summary: A join is less smooth than the continuity required of it.
codes.template: The join first fails at order {failed}, short of the order {required} required, by {gap}.

codes.name: NotConverged
codes.summary: A measure did not reach the accuracy asked within the work it is allowed.
codes.template: The measure reached an accuracy of {reached} where {asked} was asked for.

codes.name: StaleId
codes.summary: An id names no live entity of the kind wanted: it was removed, or its slot holds a newer one.
codes.template: No live entity of the kind wanted has this slot and generation: the slot holds generation {live} now, or nothing if that is 0.

codes.name: InvariantFailed
codes.summary: An edit would leave the model breaking an invariant of the B-rep, so it was not committed.
codes.template: The edit would break the invariant given as the reason, at the entities named, so the model is unchanged.

codes.name: RequestMalformed
codes.summary: The request is not JSON.
codes.template: The request is not JSON: the problem is at line {line}, column {column}.

codes.name: RequestUnsupportedSchema
codes.summary: The request uses a schema version this build cannot read.
codes.template: Request schema version {found} is not supported. This build reads version {supported}.

codes.name: UnknownOperation
codes.summary: A step asks for an operation occam does not have.
codes.template: {parameter} is {given}, which is not an operation occam has.

codes.name: NotSupported
codes.summary: A step asks for an operation occam does not do yet.
codes.template: {parameter} is {operation}, which occam does not do yet.

codes.name: InputMissing
codes.summary: A request leaves out something it needs.
codes.template: {parameter} is missing.

codes.name: InputWrongType
codes.summary: A request gives something of the wrong kind where it gives it.
codes.template: {parameter} is a {given}, where a {expected} is wanted.

codes.name: InputUnknownName
codes.summary: A request gives a name that is not one of those allowed there.
codes.template: {parameter} is {given}, which is not one of {expected}.

codes.name: InputUnknownField
codes.summary: A request gives a field that is not taken there.
codes.template: {parameter} is not a field the request takes there; it takes {expected}.

codes.name: InputUnitWrittenOut
codes.summary: A request names a unit in full where its short name is wanted.
codes.template: {parameter} is {given}, which a request writes {expected}.

codes.name: InputDuplicateLabel
codes.summary: Two steps of a request have the same label.
codes.template: {parameter} is {given}, which step {first} is already labelled.

codes.name: InputLabelNotValid
codes.summary: A label must be text that is not empty and is not an entity's id.
codes.template: {parameter} is {given}: a label is text that is not empty and is not an entity's id.

codes.name: InputUnknownLabel
codes.summary: An operand names a label no earlier step has.
codes.template: {parameter} names {given}, which no earlier step is labelled.

codes.name: InputOneOf
codes.summary: A request gives none, or more than one, of the fields that are alternatives there.
codes.template: {parameter} gives {given}, where exactly one of {expected} is wanted.

codes.name: NoLength
codes.summary: An edge would have no length: its ends, or its circle's radius, are within the band.
codes.template: {parameter} gives an edge {length} long, no longer than the band of {band}.

codes.name: PointsInLine
codes.summary: An arc's three points lie on one line, so no circle passes through them.
codes.template: {parameter} gives an arc whose middle point is {offset} from the line through its ends, no more than the band of {band}.

codes.name: ArcEndsMeet
codes.summary: An arc's two ends meet, so its three points fix no circle; a whole circle is written as a circle.
codes.template: {parameter} gives an arc whose ends are {gap} apart, no more than the band of {band}: a whole circle is written as a circle, by its centre, radius and normal.

codes.name: WireGap
codes.summary: An edge of a wire does not begin where the one before it ends.
codes.template: {parameter} begins {gap} from where the edge before it ends, at {end}, more than the band of {band}.

codes.name: WireOpen
codes.summary: A face needs a closed wire, and this one does not come back to where it begins.
codes.template: {parameter} ends {gap} from where it begins, at {start}, more than the band of {band}.

codes.name: WireCrossesItself
codes.summary: A wire touches or crosses itself.
codes.template: {parameter} touches or crosses itself at {point}, where its edges {first} and {second}, counted from 0, come within the band of {band}.

codes.name: WiresCross
codes.summary: Two wires of a face touch or cross.
codes.template: {parameter} touches or crosses the face's wire {other}, counted from 0 with the outer one first, at {point}, within the band of {band}.

codes.name: HoleOutside
codes.summary: A hole of a face is not inside its outer wire.
codes.template: {parameter} is a hole that does not lie inside the face's outer wire: it begins at {point}.

codes.name: HolesNested
codes.summary: A hole of a face lies inside another of its holes.
codes.template: {parameter} lies inside the face's wire {other}, another hole.

codes.name: NotPlanar
codes.summary: A face's wires do not lie in one plane.
codes.template: {parameter} reaches {point}, {distance} from the plane of the face's outer wire, more than the band of {band}.

codes.name: NoInterior
codes.summary: A face's wire bounds no point clear of its edges.
codes.template: {parameter} bounds no point further than {clearance} from the face's wires.

codes.name: NotAWire
codes.summary: A face names something that is not a wire it can be made from.
codes.template: {parameter} names {given}, which is not a wire a face can be made from.

codes.name: NotReadable
codes.summary: The bytes given to load are not a model in the native format.
codes.template: The file is not a native model: it fails at line {line}, column {column}.

codes.name: OtherVersion
codes.summary: A native model file is of a format version this build does not read.
codes.template: The file is format version {version}; this build reads version {supported}.

codes.name: NotSaved
codes.summary: A model holds a curve or surface of a family the native format does not write yet, so it was not saved.
codes.template: The geometry named is of a family the native format does not write yet, so nothing was saved.

codes.name: Damaged
codes.summary: A binary model file's checksum does not match its contents.
codes.template: The file's last four bytes, its CRC-32, do not match the rest of it: it was changed or damaged after it was written.

codes.name: InputNegative
codes.summary: A request gives a negative value where none may be.
codes.template: {parameter} is {value}, which is less than zero.

codes.name: InputConeRadiiEqual
codes.summary: A cone's two radii must differ.
codes.template: {parameter} is {value}, as is the cone's other radius: a cone's radii differ, and equal ones make a cylinder.

codes.name: InputNoDirection
codes.summary: A request gives a direction that is zero or not finite.
codes.template: {parameter} is zero or not finite, so it has no direction.

codes.name: InputAxesParallel
codes.summary: A frame's x axis lies along its z axis.
codes.template: {parameter} lies along the frame's z axis, so it gives no x direction across it.

codes.name: InputAngleOutOfRange
codes.summary: A request gives an angle outside the range its step allows.
codes.template: {parameter} is {value}, outside the range allowed: more than {low} and at most {high}.

codes.name: VectorInPlane
codes.summary: An extrusion's vector lies in its face's plane, so it sweeps no volume.
codes.template: {parameter} rises {height} from the face's plane, no more than the band of {band}.

codes.name: NotAProfile
codes.summary: A sweep names something that is not a profile it can sweep.
codes.template: {parameter} names {given}, which is not a profile a sweep can be made from.

codes.name: AxisOffPlane
codes.summary: A revolution's profile does not lie in one plane with its axis.
codes.template: The profile reaches {point}, {distance} from the plane through {parameter} and the profile's farthest point, more than the band of {band}.

codes.name: ProfileCrossesAxis
codes.summary: A revolution's profile lies on both sides of its axis.
codes.template: The profile reaches {point}, {distance} beyond {parameter} from its farthest point, more than the band of {band}.

codes.name: ProfileTouchesAxis
codes.summary: A revolution's profile touches its axis at a point where what it makes would pinch.
codes.template: The profile touches {parameter} at {point}, within the band of {band}, where what it makes would pinch: a profile may meet its axis only along a piece on it, at a wire's end, or at a vertex of a face turned less than a whole turn.

codes.name: MeasureNotDefined
codes.summary: A measure is asked of something that does not have it.
codes.template: {parameter} is {given}, which what the step measures does not have: it has {expected}.

codes.name: NoParameterCurve
codes.summary: A face's edge has no curve in the face's parameters, which measuring the face needs.
codes.template: The edge named has no curve in the parameters of the face named, which its area and volume are measured by.

codes.name: InputScaleNotPositive
codes.summary: A scale factor is not greater than zero.
codes.template: {parameter} is {value}, which is not greater than zero: a scale grows or shrinks, and never turns inside out.

codes.name: NotABody
codes.summary: A transform or a copy names something that is not a body.
codes.template: {parameter} names {given}, which is not a body.

codes.name: NoExactForm
codes.summary: A curve or surface has no exact form under a scale that differs along its axes.
codes.template: The geometry named has no exact form under the scale {parameter} gives, which differs along its axes, and occam does not approximate it.

codes.name: Incomplete
codes.summary: A section of two surfaces stopped before it was complete; what it found is kept.
codes.template: The section stopped with {curves} curves and {contacts} contacts found, and more may be missing.

codes.name: HitsIncomplete
codes.summary: The hits of a curve on a surface stopped before they were complete; what was found is kept.
codes.template: The hits stopped with {hits} points and {overlaps} overlaps found, and more may be missing.

codes.name: Undecided
codes.summary: A decision cannot be made at this resolution: the value's certified enclosure reaches across an edge of the band.
codes.template: The value {quantity}, certified to within {radius}, cannot be placed against the band of {band}.

codes.name: FitOutsideBand
codes.summary: A curve fitted to traced points, or an image of it, is not within the band of both surfaces; it is kept with its fit.
codes.template: The curve fitted to {points} traced points and its images lie within {reached} of both surfaces, outside the band of {band}.

codes.name: LimitNotPositive
codes.summary: A limit a mesh is made to must be a finite number greater than zero.
codes.template: {parameter} is {value}, which is not a finite number greater than zero.

codes.name: EdgeOverCap
codes.summary: An edge would need more samples than one edge may have at the deflection asked.
codes.template: The edge would need more than {cap} samples at a deflection of {deflection}.

codes.name: FaceNotMeshed
codes.summary: A face could not be meshed, so the mesh leaves a hole where it is.
codes.template: The face could not be meshed, for the reason given; the faces around it are meshed without it.

codes.name: NotWatertight
codes.summary: The mesh is not watertight: a face is missing, a segment is not used once each way, or a shell's counts are wrong.
codes.template: The mesh is not watertight, for the reason given, at the entities named.

codes.name: WebgpuMissing
codes.summary: The browser has no WebGPU, which the viewer draws with.
codes.template: This browser has no WebGPU, which the viewer draws with.

codes.name: NoAdapter
codes.summary: The browser has WebGPU but gave the page no GPU adapter.
codes.template: The browser has WebGPU but gave the page no GPU adapter, so the viewer cannot draw.

codes.name: NoDevice
codes.summary: The GPU adapter would not give the page a device.
codes.template: The GPU adapter would not give the page a device: {reason}

codes.name: DeviceLost
codes.summary: The GPU device was lost, so the page has stopped drawing.
codes.template: The GPU device was lost, so the page has stopped drawing: {reason}

codes.name: MeshMalformed
codes.summary: The page was given a mesh that breaks the renderer contract, which is a bug in occam.
codes.template: The page was given a mesh that breaks the renderer contract, which is a bug in occam: {reason}. It still draws the last good model.

codes.name: MeshFailed
codes.summary: A mesh worker could not mesh some of the model's faces, so the page draws the model without them.
codes.template: A mesh worker could not mesh {faces}, so the page draws the model without them: {reason}

codes.name: ModelMissing
codes.summary: The model the viewer watches is not there.
codes.template: There is no model at {given}: the viewer keeps watching, and its page draws the model once a run writes it.

codes.name: PortTaken
codes.summary: The port the viewer was asked to listen on is taken.
codes.template: Port {port} is taken on this machine, so the viewer could not listen there.

codes.name: StateNotWritten
codes.summary: The viewer's state file could not be written, so no viewer was started.
codes.template: The viewer's state file {given} could not be written, so no viewer was started for the model.

codes.name: NotStarted
codes.summary: The viewer's server did not start.
codes.template: The viewer for {given} did not start: its server stopped before it listened.

codes.name: NotStopped
codes.summary: The viewer's server did not stop when asked.
codes.template: The viewer for {given}, process {pid}, still answered {seconds} seconds after it was asked to stop.

codes.name: RayMissed
codes.summary: A ray hits no face of the mesh and passes no edge within the tolerance.
codes.template: The ray from {from} hits no face of the model's mesh and passes no edge within {tolerance} of it.

codes.name: SelectionStale
codes.summary: The selection was made on another model than the file holds now.
codes.template: The selection was made on another model than {given} holds now, so it names nothing: select again.

codes.name: SkillPresent
codes.summary: Another skill is where `occam skill --install` writes the occam skill, so it was left as it was.
codes.template: {given} holds a skill other than this build's occam skill, so it was left as it was; --force replaces it.

codes.name: SkillNotWritten
codes.summary: The occam skill could not be written into the project.
codes.template: The occam skill could not be written to {given}.

remedies.name: UseModelTolerance
remedies.summary: Ask for the model's tolerance, or for a coarser one.

remedies.name: UseThreads
remedies.summary: Run on the number of threads given. One thread needs none started, so it always works.

remedies.name: MeetAt
remedies.summary: Move the end the report names to the point given, so that the two ends meet.

remedies.name: UseCircle
remedies.summary: Write the edge the report names as a whole circle with the centre, radius and normal given.

remedies.name: UseDeflection
remedies.summary: Mesh at the deflection given, at which the edge the report names fits under its cap.

remedies.name: UseWebgpuBrowser
remedies.summary: Open the page in a current Chromium or Firefox, which draw with WebGPU.

remedies.name: TurnOnWebgpu
remedies.summary: Turn on WebGPU and hardware acceleration in the browser's settings; in Chromium, chrome://gpu says why WebGPU is off.

remedies.name: MakeModel
remedies.summary: Make the model by running a request on it with `occam run --model`; the viewer draws it once it is written.

remedies.name: UseAnyPort
remedies.summary: Leave out --port, so that the viewer listens on a free port.

remedies.name: AimAt
remedies.summary: Pick again from the same point with --towards at the point given, the centre of a triangle of the mesh.

remedies.name: SelectAgain
remedies.summary: Select again in the viewer's page, which draws the model as the file holds it now; ask the person to, if the selection is theirs.

remedies.name: UseForce
remedies.summary: Run the same command again with --force, which replaces the file the report names.
